description: This file defines the GammaDistribution class, which implements the gamma probability distribution, including methods for density, cumulative probability, sampling, and parameters such as shape and scale.

classes.name: GammaDistribution
classes.description: Implements the gamma distribution, providing methods for probability density, cumulative probability, sampling, and parameter access.

methods.name: getShape
methods.description: Returns the shape parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the scale parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function value at a given point, with overflow handling.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the density function at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative probability up to a value x using the regularized gamma function.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the gamma distribution using algorithms appropriate for the shape parameter.
